ohlson.note: Value is null: SIZE (no GNP price level index in the inputs; no GDP deflator in the market note). Partial sum shown covers every other term. FFO defined as net income plus D&A = -244.6 (FFOTL term 0.212). Adding back the 227.7 non cash pension settlement loss would give FFO -16.9. CHIN uses FY2024 and FY2025 attributable net loss. INTWO = 1 (losses in FY2024 and FY2025). To reach O <= 0 the SIZE term -0.407*ln(TA/index) would have to be <= -4.72, i.e. TA/index >= 109336 (unit convention of TA, thousands versus millions, is itself undefined without the index).
missing_terms: SIZE (no GNP price level index in the inputs; no GDP deflator in the market note)

method: Start: cash 324.3 at 30 Jun 2026. H2 2026 FCF = full year guidance (-25) minus H1 actual (-74.5) = +49.5; end 2026 cash = 373.8.
2026 pre item cash base = FCF guidance + capex 85 + cash taxes 70 + net interest 70 + other payments 30 + pension and postretirement 102 = 332 (arithmetic on the Investor Day guidance items).

2027 to 2030: revenue falls 4.25% a year (midpoint of constant currency (5.0)% to (3.5)%); non GAAP operating margin held at 10% (midpoint of 9% to 11%); pre item cash = revenue x 10% + K, K = 332 - 2026 margin profit (D&A and other non profit items implied by guidance, held flat).

Deductions each year: capex 85, cash taxes 70, other payments 30 (all held at 2026 guidance), cash interest 698.4 x 10.625% = 74.2, pension per the 10-K schedule: 105 for 2027; 241 for 2028 to 2030 spread evenly (80.33 a year; the 10-K gives no split by year).

Not modelled: the other debt amortisation and finance lease payments (5.4, 4.3, 2.4, 1.2, 0.0 scheduled excl. leases), FX, any ABL draw, any note repurchases, postretirement contributions after 2026 (about 3 a year, not in the 10-K DB schedule), working capital swings.
The 2027 DB figure is 105 in the 10-K and Q1 10-Q, 104 in the Q2 10-Q; the spec figure 105 is used.
Pension 2026 uses the 102 Investor Day figure (pension plus postretirement) because the 332 base is built from the deck items. The 10-Q basis is 97 + 3 = 100.

drift_mu_equals_1y_stock_return.formula: V = E + F; sigma_D = 0.05 + 0.25 sigma_E; sigma_V = E/V sigma_E + F/V sigma_D; DD = [ln(V/F) + (mu - 0.5 sigma_V^2) T] / (sigma_V sqrt T); PD = N(-DD); T = 1; mu = past 1 year stock return
drift_mu_equals_1y_stock_return.note: Debt F is 10-Q carrying total debt 733.5; volatility taken as is from market_inputs.json.

drift_mu_equals_1y_treasury.formula: V = E + F; sigma_D = 0.05 + 0.25 sigma_E; sigma_V = E/V sigma_E + F/V sigma_D; DD = [ln(V/F) + (mu - 0.5 sigma_V^2) T] / (sigma_V sqrt T); PD = N(-DD); T = 1; mu = 1 year Treasury 4.47%
drift_mu_equals_1y_treasury.note: Sensitivity drift; the two rows are not averaged.

alt_face_debt_745.note: Same model with F = face debt 745.0 instead of carrying 733.5.

bond_implied_default_probability.formula: spread s = YTM - matched Treasury; hazard = s/(1-R); PD(1y) = 1 - exp(-hazard); cumulative = 1 - exp(-hazard*T)

alt_10q_fair_value_30jun2026.note: 10-Q Level 2 fair value 658.0 on face 698.4 (implied price 94.2), Treasury 4.18% on 30 Jun 2026.

bond_implied_default_probability.caveat: Risk neutral hazard including liquidity and risk premia; overstates the real world PD. A single thinly traded print.

one_year_change_in_market_cap.formula: market cap now - (close on 2025-10-09 x 72,915,955 shares)
one_year_change_in_market_cap.note: Constant share count (72,915,955) applied to both dates, so the percentage equals the price return. Shares in Oct 2025 were fewer (about 71.3m in Jan 2026 per 10-K cover), so the true market cap change is slightly different.
